title: triticum roegneri
intro: Triticum roegneri, commonly known as 'Roegneri wheat', is a type of wheat plant that belongs to the Poaceae family. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including its ability to lower cholesterol levels, regulate blood sugar, and provide antioxidant properties that may help reduce inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Triticum roegneri include its potential to improve cardiovascular health, reduce the risk of certain cancers, and support immune function. The bioactive constituents of this plant include phenolic acids, flavonoids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and have been studied for their potential therapeutic effects.
